record.paper: Islands in minor-closed classes. I. Bounded treewidth and separators

dossier_meta.paper: Islands in minor-closed classes. I. Bounded treewidth and separators
dossier_meta.statement_text: A minor-closed class of graphs $\mathcal{G}$ satisfies $\mathrm{col}^\star(\mathcal{G}) \leq t$ if and only if there exists $m \geq 1$ such that $K_{t,m} \notin \mathcal{G}$ and $I_{t-1}+P_m \notin \mathcal{G}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Observation 3 shows that any class $\mathcal{G}$ with $\mathrm{col}^\star(\mathcal{G}) \leq t$ can contain only finitely many graphs of the form $K_{t,m}$ or $I_{t-1}+P_m$; the conjecture asserts that this necessary condition is also sufficient for minor-closed classes. Theorem 7 confirms the conjecture for the special case of minor-closed classes of bounded treewidth, and Conjecture 4 would imply $\chi^\star_{\ell}(\mathcal{G}) = \mathrm{col}^\star(\mathcal{G})$ for every minor-closed class.
